notes: Predeclared synthetic experiment; targets are not application or operational accuracy budgets.
The 22 paired cases are exactly F1; six time probes change only CFL and private study identity.
First and last reconstructed slopes are zero; the outlet observable remains the last cell average proxy.
The candidate is pure nonnegative-flow advection with prescribed inlet; nonzero D, decay, source and closed boundaries are unsupported.
Candidate errors are coupled space/time. Time-step differences and observed orders are empirical sensitivity, not certified error bounds.
Only the baseline uses the upwind Poisson semidiscrete reference. Reference disagreement above 1e-10 mg/L is an integrity failure.
No clipping, tail renormalization, old-threshold changes, production promotion or extension of the 54-proposition Lean claim.
Exit 0: integrity passed and all study targets met; exit 1: completed with targets unmet; exit 2: execution, input or integrity failure.
